description: Open-DSOPF builds a three-phase unbalanced optimal-power-flow model in Pyomo by extracting network data from OpenDSS. The repository supplies a tutorial and a British low-voltage photovoltaic test case. The provider is ValentinRigoni (repository owner). Coverage: The formulation can use compatible OpenDSS networks. Its documented study example is local, with dates and detailed resolution not established in the README. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The README explicitly assigns GNU GPL version 3 to the model. OpenDSS, Pyomo and solvers are separate dependencies. Limitations: The documented example and publication do not establish independent maintenance or accuracy across all networks. For simulation it supports comparison of active distribution-network management strategies. Related resources: The model explicitly extracts network information from platform-opendss.
